verdict.rationale: Exa provides an official JS/TS SDK (exa-js on GitHub) with documented methods like search, answer, streamSearch, and webSearch tool helper for agentic loops, plus extensive API docs backing the SDK's functionality; MCP server further supports AI-native integration. Missing for 10: independent corroboration of SDK reliability/quality beyond vendor docs and GitHub examples, and no evidence of multi-language SDK coverage beyond JS.
